_HOW_TO_ADD_A_CONCERN: 1. Copy any block in 'concerns' and give it a new unique 'id' and 'display_name'.
2. Write 3-5 'prototypes': plain-English sentences describing what the sender wants.
These are what the embedding layer matches against. Write them as descriptions,
not as keywords. This is the whole ML authoring surface - no training, no code.
3. Add 'examples': short real-ish phrasings you have actually seen (identifiers faked).
4. Add 'keyword_rules.positive' phrases that are strong giveaways.
5. List 'fields' the concern needs. Reference a pattern by 'pattern_ref' from
patterns.library.json - do not write regex here.
NOTE: confidence is shrunk when a concern has fewer than 4 prototypes+examples
combined, so a thin concern always routes to human review until you flesh it out.
That is deliberate - see pipeline SP-1.1-20.

concerns.description_internal: Sender asks which bill type a charge falls under, or submits a bill that needs its type-of-bill code categorized or corrected.
prototypes: The sender is asking which type of bill applies to a submitted charge on a workers compensation claim.
A provider or adjuster wants to know how a specific charge amount on a claim should be classified by bill type.
Question about the type of bill code assigned to a billed charge for a claim.
The sender says the type of bill on a submitted claim is wrong and needs to be corrected.
examples: Can you confirm the type of bill for claim WC1234567, charge amount $1,250.00?
What TOB should be used for this charge on claim ABC-00456789?
The type of bill code 0111 looks incorrect for this billed amount, please advise.
Need the bill type classification for the attached charge on this claim.

concerns.description_internal: PLACEHOLDER. Sender requests a copy of an Explanation of Review for a claim or date of service.
prototypes: The sender is requesting a copy of the explanation of review for a claim.
A provider asks to be sent the EOR document covering a specific date of service.
Request to resend or forward the explanation of review paperwork for a claim.
examples: Please send a copy of the EOR for claim WC1234567.
Can I get the explanation of review for date of service 03/14/2026?

concerns.description_internal: PLACEHOLDER. Sender disputes a reduction or denial and asks for the bill to be reconsidered or reprocessed.
prototypes: The sender disputes how a bill was reduced or denied and asks for reconsideration.
A provider is appealing the payment amount on a claim and wants the bill reprocessed.
Request to review a denied or underpaid charge again and adjust the payment.
examples: Requesting reconsideration of the reduced charge on claim WC1234567 for $1,250.00.
This bill was denied in error, please reprocess claim ABC-00456789.

concerns.description_internal: PLACEHOLDER. Sender asks whether a bill has been paid, or when payment will issue.
prototypes: The sender is asking whether payment has been issued for a bill on a claim.
A provider wants to know the status of a check or EFT for an outstanding invoice.
Follow up asking when payment will be released for a submitted charge.
examples: Has payment issued on claim WC1234567? Invoice INV-889231.
Checking status of check #558201 for this claim.
